project.name: Netbeans Plugin Kotlin Refactoring
project.description: K2-based refactoring computers for the NetBeans Kotlin plugin. Contains pure analysis logic (no NetBeans UI deps): KaRenameComputer, TextChange, and IDEA data structures (KotlinPsiRange, KotlinPsiUnificationResult) compiled from submodules/IntellijCommunity/plugins/kotlin/base/psi/src/org/jetbrains/kotlin/idea/base/psi/unifier/. Used by the Nbm module for all K2 refactoring operations (rename, safe delete, etc.).
